claim: Apple's FY2025 capex was $12.71 billion, up 35% year over year but still below the company's 2018 capex level.
stance_target: Scale of Apple's AI-era capital investment relative to history and hyperscalers
quoted_support: Apple spent $12.71 billion on capital expenditures in the year ended in September, up 35% on an annual basis, but less than the company spent in 2018.

claim: Google, Microsoft, Meta and Amazon committed a collective $380 billion in capex in 2025, dwarfing Apple's spend.
stance_target: Apple is dramatically underspending hyperscalers on AI infrastructure
quoted_support: Google, Microsoft, Meta and Amazon committed a collective $380 billion this year on capital expenditures, much of it on Nvidia-based data centers.

claim: Apple's AI/ML strategy chief John Giannandrea announced retirement in December 2025, with responsibilities split among COO Sabih Khan, services chief Eddy Cue, and new hire Amar Subramanya (ex-Google Gemini engineering head), reporting to Craig Federighi.
stance_target: Whether Apple's AI leadership shake-up signals course correction (execution failure) or normal transition
quoted_support: Apple said John Giannandrea, the company's machine learning and AI strategy chief, would retire in 2026... The hiring of Subramanya, who was the head of engineering for Google Gemini before briefly joining Microsoft in an AI executive role, is particularly notable.

quoted_support: Altman told journalists that he believes OpenAI's real rival isn't Google, but Apple. He said smartphones are not well-suited for AI companions or other use cases.

claim: OpenAI acquired Jony Ive's AI devices startup io for $6.4 billion in 2025, positioning it to build a post-smartphone consumer AI device.
stance_target: AI relocates the interface away from the device
quoted_support: OpenAI bought io, former Apple design guru Jony Ive's AI devices startup, for $6.4 billion, and now Ive is helping the AI lab build next-generation consumer devices.
